diagnosis.what_happened: Orchestrator emitted full Chapter 5 Planning Report entirely in Persian (8,000+ chars) in the conversational interface.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Failure resulted from token context saturation after sequential inspection of 8 Persian thesis artifacts. A missing conversational language decoupling check caused the language from the inspected artifacts to bleed into the conversational response.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Enforce strict conversational output decoupling in English regardless of artifact target language.
diagnosis.rationale_why: All conversational interactions must remain exclusively in English as per Directive 6.

desired_behavior: English-only for all meta-conversational and status reports regardless of artifact language
generalization: Conversational output must be decoupled from the artifact target language and maintained in English across all orchestration turns.

evidence.observed_value: Defective Persian output observed in conversational interface
